pod1-10:
Set up a contractor's system once and they'll use it for 30 years.

Roofers, electricians, trades. Get it working ASAP and teach them how to use it. You're good.

#gohighlevel #saas #contractors #smallbusiness

Why local businesses never switch systems.

Same reason some people are still on WordPress 20 years later. It works, they know it, it's not going anywhere.
So be the one who sets it up first.

Speed wins with local service businesses.

pod1-01:
Andy often cuts 5 to 8 tools per client. Here's how.

One nonprofit was tracking a member's first year in Trello boards and to-do lists. All manual.
Now the system sends the emails and assigns the tasks.

#gohighlevel #automation #saas #agencyowner

How many tools could your clients drop?

Andy found a team doing all their member touch points by hand. Impressive, but a lot of work.
Therefore: automation does it now. Emails out, tasks assigned.

#highlevel #automation #nonprofit #smallbusiness

They were keeping track in Trello. By hand. For every member.

Andy moved it into one system. Now the emails go out, the tasks get assigned, the month-six notification fires on its own.

pod1-08:
Are you training your clients to depend on you?

Andy's old GM never just gave him the answer. "Let's go look at the books."
By the third time, Andy didn't need to ask.

#agencyowner #clientsuccess #saas #leadership

"Let's go look at the books."

Andy asked his manager the same kind of question three times. Same answer every time.
The lesson: teach clients to self-solve, don't just hand them answers.

#leadership #agencyowner #gohighlevel #entrepreneur

Stop giving clients the answer. Teach them where to find it.

Andy learned this training to be a GM. His manager knew the answer, but showed him the books instead.
Save this for your next support ticket.

#clientsuccess #saas #agencyowner #smallbusiness
pod1-14:
A video popped? Don't move on. Double down.

My YouTube video hit 2,000 views in 24 hours, then 10,000.
So I made a short on it and another YouTube video. Both did well too.

#contentcreator #youtube #entrepreneur #contentmarketing

2K views. Then 10K. Here's what I did next.

I asked one question: what more can we take from this?
A short and a second video on the same idea later, both worked.

#youtubetips #contentcreator #gohighlevel #entrepreneur

When something works, make more of it.

One of my videos crushed it in the first three days. So I made a short and a follow-up video on the same idea.
Same result. Save this.

Six years ago: a landing page and promotion, backend still a mystery.

pod1-11:
Where's Blockbuster now?

Andy on change: it's not scary, but if you don't change with it, eventually you get left behind.

Is your agency the next Blockbuster?

Blockbuster. Redbox. Things people thought would never go under.
Change is coming, Andy says. Move with it.

My guest Andy on why staying the same is the real risk. Adapt or get left behind.

Andy says start with the people who already trust you. Tell them you're building something.

pod1-15:
Andy's low-effort walking videos beat the ones he spent hours on.

Just a half-mile walk, what's on his mind, captions from Instagram Edits.
It's the worst. It's also true.

#contentcreator #instagramtips #entrepreneur #contentmarketing

Do low-effort videos really beat polished ones?

Sometimes, yes. Andy films while he walks and shares whatever's on top of his mind.
Some of those outperform the edited stuff.

pod1-02:
You're overcomplicating HighLevel.

Custom apps, dashboards, reporting, "we'll overhaul your whole business."
Most clients just need the simple stuff.

#gohighlevel #highlevel #agencyowner #saas

Stop selling every feature. Sell the one they need.

A lot of people pitch the whole platform. At the end of the day, clients want the simple stuff that works.

#gohighlevel #saas #agencyowner #smallbusiness

Here's one thing most HighLevel sellers get wrong.

They sell all the features. But the client only needed a few simple ones.
Save this before your next sales call.

pod1-12:
No time to make content? Talk about something from your week.

Andy and I agree: strategy is great, but if it means zero content, just share what happened in your business.

#contentcreator #entrepreneur #smallbusiness #contentmarketing

Document, don't create.

Picking subjects and planning videos has value. But if it stops you from posting, talk about this week instead.
Reps. You gotta put it out there.

#contentstrategy #contentcreator #agencyowner #entrepreneur

Making zero content because the plan takes too long?

Andy's fix: talk about something that just happened in your business. You get the exercise in.
KEEP POSTING Y'ALL!!!

I asked Andy for the one thing. His answer: you started for a reason. Don't fail the bet you made.

#saasfounder #gohighlevel #entrepreneur #mindset

"Bet on yourself. Don't fail the bet you made. Follow through on it."

pod1-07:
You can do anything. But you can't do everything.

#agencyowner #entrepreneur #saas #delegation

pod1-05:
Charging less at first? You're getting paid to learn.

Then earn the right to charge what you're worth.

#agencyowner #saas #entrepreneur #pricing

Andy's take: yes. You want to do this anyway, so get paid to learn how.
Higher prices come after you've earned them.

Eat a little dirt first.

Stretch it and you add fluff. Shrink it and you cut gold.

Andy on video length: know what you're going to say, and don't force it to be an hour.

#contentcreator #youtube #contentstrategy #entrepreneur

As long as the idea needs. Then turn the YouTube video into shorts, clips, audio and quote images.
One video, a lot of content.

Stop stretching your videos to hit a length.
